article.story: RUSTON, La. -- — Braylon Wenger scored 21 points as Louisiana Tech beat Jacksonville State 68-63 on Tuesday. Wenger also had six rebounds and three steals for the Bulldogs (3-2). Jaylen Fenner scored 18 points, shooting 7 for 13 (3 for 4 from 3-point range) and 1 of 3 from the free-throw line. Iyran Francis Jr. shot 5 of 9 from the field to finish with 11 points. Jordan Stiemke led the Gamecocks (2-3) with 19 points. Naas Cunningham added 13 points and Leon Horner scored 12. Francis scored eight points in the first half and Louisiana Tech went into halftime trailing 29-26. Wenger's 15-point second half helped Louisiana Tech rally for the victory. Up next: Louisiana Tech next plays Thursday against Tulane at home, and Jacksonville State will host Georgia State on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
